title: PROJECTS pill: step from the open projects to their labels' open-issue counts and each label's issues
summary: A PROJECTS pill in the top bar steps from the open projects to each project's labels with open-issue counts and then to that label's issues, which open on GitHub; a remembered lock switches between counting blocked issues and ready only, using the issue map's blocked rule.

deferred.what: A project whose only remote is not on GitHub (a gitlab.com origin) is mapped to NotAuthenticated, so the PROJECTS pill tells a logged-in user 'Not authenticated with GitHub. Run gh auth login' with Try again instead of greying the project out with 'no GitHub repository'
deferred.why: The fix changes the shared gh error mapping in src-tauri/src/github/runner.rs, outside this story's seam
